def: the largest number or very large

occurrences.text: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:
And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.
If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
